name: gizza-ai/video-audio-track-selector
summary: Keep one chosen audio track from a video and drop the rest

tool.description: Keep exactly one chosen audio track from a video that has multiple audio tracks (e.g. a multi-language file) and drop the other audio tracks. Pick the track by its 0-based index (track=0 keeps the first audio track). Lossless — the video and the kept audio are stream-copied (no re-encode). Optionally keep subtitle tracks too. Provide the video as either url (HTTP/HTTPS) or ref (id from a prior tool call). Note: runs on the standalone page and the CLI (chat ffmpeg is unavailable).

keep_subtitles.description: Also keep any embedded subtitle tracks (stream-copied). Off by default, so only the video plus the one chosen audio track remain.

ref.description: Reference id from a prior tool call. Use either url or ref.

set_default.description: Flag the kept audio track as the default audio disposition so players auto-select it. On by default; turn off to leave disposition flags untouched.

track.description: 0-based index of the audio track to KEEP: 0 = first audio track, 1 = second, 2 = third, and so on. Every other audio track is removed. Fails if the video has no audio track at that index (e.g. track=1 on a single-audio file).

url.description: Video URL (HTTP/HTTPS). Use either url or ref.
